notes:
Account snapshot / shorthand:
- Company: mid-market sales enablement SaaS; building outbound SDR chat agents that actually take CRM/email/calendar actions (’book demo’, update lead status).
- Primary ask: low-latency streaming (fast token streaming + tool-calling) with reliable function/tool integrations for Salesforce & Google Calendar. Need ability to stream partial responses to UI within ~150-250ms first-byte under normal load; target p95 end-to-end <300ms, p99 as low as possible for Dedicated.
- Current state: using competitor SDK (OpenAI) in prod pilot; seeing sporadic tail latency and function-call timeouts at scale. Want Redwood hosted API POC to validate steady-state token latency and tool-call reliability before committing to Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Quote from CTO on 02/25: "We need streaming to feel instantaneous for reps — any visible lag kills adoption."
- POC goals: 2-week hosted run with 200-500 concurrent virtual reps, scripted edge cases (concurrent calendar writes, Salesforce upserts), collect token-level traces, and validate KV/prefix caching behavior. If p95/p99 SLOs pass and tool-calls meet retry SLAs, move to pricing for Dedicated (monthly reserve + burst).
- Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs sent to Splunk, KMS for key management, potential EU data residency for subset of customers. Legal requested retention controls and DSAR process; security packet linked in drive.
- Commercial: estimated ARR band $60k-$180k; procurement timeline aggressive — target decision by 2026-06. Main negotiation points: Dedicated burst pricing, minimum commit, and emergency fallback to hosted endpoints.
- Next immediate: AE to confirm POC measurement dashboard metrics; SE to provide synthetic load scripts and endpoint config; infra/legal to receive SOC2 + diagram (done).
- Related artifacts: pricing deck (drive:/deals/sundial/Redwood_Pricing_v2.pdf), security Q&A (drive:/security/sundial/SecQ&A.docx), POC plan (drive:/poc/sundial/streaming-test-plan.md).
